Catalan

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): (Central, Balearic) [di.fə.ɾən.siˈa]
  • IPA(key): (Valencia) [di.fe.ɾen.siˈaɾ]
  • Audio (Barcelona):(file)
  • Rhymes: -a(ɾ)

Verb

[edit]

diferenciar (first-person singular present diferencio, first-person singular preterite diferencií, past participle diferenciat)

  1. to tell the difference, differentiate
  2. (mathematics) to differentiate

Ido

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from English differentiate, French différencier, German differenzieren, Italian differenziare, Russian дифференци́ровать (differencírovatʹ), Spanish diferenciar.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /diferenˈt͡siar/

Verb

[edit]

diferenciar (present tense diferencias, past tense diferenciis, future tense diferencios, imperative diferenciez, conditional diferencius)

  1. (transitive, intransitive, biology, sociology) to differentiate, to acquire or give a distinct or separate character

Conjugation

[edit]

Portuguese

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • diferençar

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /d͡ʒi.fe.ɾẽ.siˈa(ʁ)/ [d͡ʒi.fe.ɾẽ.sɪˈa(h)], (faster pronunciation) /d͡ʒi.fe.ɾẽˈsja(ʁ)/ [d͡ʒi.fe.ɾẽˈsja(h)]
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /d͡ʒi.fe.ɾẽ.siˈa(ʁ)/ [d͡ʒi.fe.ɾẽ.sɪˈa(h)], (faster pronunciation) /d͡ʒi.fe.ɾẽˈsja(ʁ)/ [d͡ʒi.fe.ɾẽˈsja(h)]
    • (São Paulo) IPA(key): /d͡ʒi.fe.ɾẽ.siˈa(ɾ)/ [d͡ʒi.fe.ɾẽ.sɪˈa(ɾ)], (faster pronunciation) /d͡ʒi.fe.ɾẽˈsja(ɾ)/
    • (Rio de Janeiro) IPA(key): /d͡ʒi.fe.ɾẽ.siˈa(ʁ)/ [d͡ʒi.fe.ɾẽ.sɪˈa(χ)], (faster pronunciation) /d͡ʒi.fe.ɾẽˈsja(ʁ)/ [d͡ʒi.fe.ɾẽˈsja(χ)]
    • (Caipira) IPA(key): /d͡ʒi.fe.ɾẽ.siˈa(ɻ)/ [d͡ʒi.fe.ɾẽ.sɪˈa(ɻ)], (faster pronunciation) /d͡ʒi.fe.ɾẽˈsja(ɻ)/
 
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /di.fɨ.ɾẽˈsjaɾ/
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /di.fɨ.ɾẽˈsjaɾ/
    • (Southern Portugal) IPA(key): /di.fɨ.ɾẽˈsja.ɾi/

  • Hyphenation: di‧fe‧ren‧ci‧ar

Verb

[edit]

diferenciar (first-person singular present diferencio, first-person singular preterite diferenciei, past participle diferenciado)

  1. to differentiate (to perceive the difference between things)
    Synonym: discriminar
  2. (mathematics) to differentiate (to calculate the differential of a function of multiple variables)

Spanish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From diferencia (“difference”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /difeɾenˈθjaɾ/ [d̪i.fe.ɾẽn̟ˈθjaɾ] (Equatorial Guinea, Spain)
  • IPA(key): /difeɾenˈsjaɾ/ [d̪i.fe.ɾẽnˈsjaɾ] (Latin America, Philippines)
  • Rhymes: -aɾ
  • Syllabification: di‧fe‧ren‧ciar

Verb

[edit]

diferenciar (first-person singular present diferencio, first-person singular preterite diferencié, past participle diferenciado)

  1. (transitive) to differentiate (to show the difference between two things)
